result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six listings plus the lookup by code. The full offline test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures), including a new test that checks the SUMMER/PLAIN case you described.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(500)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. Null means no description.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new `createPromotion(..., category, description)` overload. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. The existing 5-argument method stays and delegates with a null description, so the ~60 existing call sites compile unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the INSERT in `createPromotion` writes the description. Every promotion SELECT reads it: `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion`, `listUnusedPromotions`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInAllListings` test.

I did not add descriptions to the demo data in `DemoScenario`, since the task didn't ask for it. Nothing is committed.
